# netbox_module_bay_templates (Data Source)

Lists module_bay_template objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_module_bay_templates" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-module_bay_template" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. - `module_bay_templates` (Attributes List) The matching module_bay_templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--module_bay_templates))

### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

### Nested Schema for `module_bay_templates`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the module bay is enabled.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `module_type_id` (Number) Id of the module type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `name` (String)
- `position` (String) Identifier of the bay's position, substituted into the names of the module's components.
- `url` (String)
